rationale.scripts/**: Validator, composition helper, generator and registry implementation self-protection, including future direct scripts.
rationale.src/**: Native Astro/MDX/component/config publication sources, including future protected source families and reader metadata/config owners.
rationale.data/**: Publication manifests, route/source metadata, baselines and registries consumed by light validators.
rationale.migration/**: Page ownership, route migration and legacy-reference authority consumed transitively by light validators.
rationale.**/*.html: Legacy/current root publication corpus walked by validate, SEO, editorial and audit-pro checks.
rationale.**/*.js: JavaScript source/corpus files read by SEO/audit checks and validator implementations.
rationale.**/*.mjs: Node/ESM validator and build/config inputs reachable from the light gate or its authority helpers.
rationale.**/*.cjs: CommonJS validator/helper/config inputs reachable from the light gate or its authority helpers.
rationale.**/*.ts: Typed publication/config sources outside or inside src that may be consumed by validators.
rationale.**/*.tsx: Typed JSX publication sources that can affect static publication validation.
rationale.**/*.jsx: JSX publication sources that can affect static publication validation.
rationale.**/*.css: CSS publication corpus validated directly by validate/audit-pro/css layer checks.
rationale.**/*.json: JSON manifests/config/registries read by data, route, search, baseline and publication checks.
rationale.**/*.svg: Repository-local publication media whose existence/bytes can be validated through manifests or HTML.
rationale.**/*.png: Repository-local publication/social media validated through HTML/manifests.
rationale.**/*.jpg: Repository-local publication/social media validated through HTML/manifests.
rationale.**/*.jpeg: Repository-local publication/social media validated through HTML/manifests.
rationale.**/*.webp: Repository-local publication/social media validated through HTML/manifests.
rationale.**/*.avif: Repository-local publication/social media validated through HTML/manifests.
